title: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India, (2018) 10 SCC 1
content.holding: IPC 377 read down for consenting adults. BNS does not re-enact 377. Consensual same-sex intimacy is not an offence; non-consensual male rape is a legislative gap.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Crl.) No. 76 of 2016; 2018 INSC 790; (2018) 10 SCC 1.
